selection_policy.optional: U+1022 through U+1027; U+1022 is not required
selection_policy.partial_exception: Keep a draft with explicit gaps if an extended character was observed.
selection_policy.discard: No complete core and no counted extra appears in the compiled variables or rules; include-only fragments are retained as dependencies.
selection_policy.unverified: Potential target characters exist, but no applicable keyboard output was observed in the bounded probes.

probe.scope: All 95 printable US-keyboard single presses and 9,025 pairs, plus selected longer literal-context sequences. Source compilation used temporary icon-free copies and preserved includes.
probe.evidence: draft-layouts.json preserves each single-key output and representative full-output witnesses; original source/binary SHA-256 values are in sources.json.
limits: Unobserved is not impossible: long or non-US/modifier contexts are not exhaustively explored.
Observed counts include code points inside larger outputs and do not imply standalone keys.
A compiled-table value is a candidate only; it may be an input, an unused variable, or unreachable.
The original GPL-2.0 engine is external to this proprietary repository.
Original keyboard license status is recorded per source; unknown-license originals are not committed.

verification.note: Replay verifies recorded outputs under the same bounded engine simulation, not native keyboard applications or completeness.
